questions.question:
3.1
An AC generator produces a maximum potential difference of 240 V. The resistance of the appliance connected to the generator is 80 Ω.

3.1.1 Calculate the rms potential difference.

3.1.2 Calculate the average power dissipated by the appliance.

3.1.3 Calculate the cost of operating the appliance for 2 hours if the cost of electricity is R2.50 per kWh.

(8)
questions.answer:
3.1.1

Vrms = Vmax/√2
Vrms = 240/√2
Vrms = 169.71 V

(2)

3.1.2

Pave = Vrms²/R
Pave = (169.71)²/80
Pave = 360.00 W
Pave = 0.36 kW

(3)

3.1.3

E = PΔt
E = 0.36 × 2
E = 0.72 kWh

Cost = E × tariff
Cost = 0.72 × 2.50
Cost = R1.80

(3)
